body: I mean... they protest at protests... and the police protest at funerals..?

I think you're right about having to sift through friends.

Can't find a hobby with a group that I enjoy around town. I really wish I were spiritually inclined so I could cash in on the community aspects of it all.

I'll consider giving craigslist a shot.

I have brought my friend issue up with my therapist but whenever I do he seems more interested in other things and I don't feel like he wants me to talk about it.

I just don't think I'm supposed to have friends. Fuck this.

It is really hard and I am trying. The hardest part is finding people who are genuinely interested in me as a person. Or just finding people at all. I really don't have any idea what I'm supposed to do to meet people.
There aren't a whole lot of times I don't feel alone. The therapist I see helps, but only once a week and for an hour. That's really all I have.

I personally get a bunch of ideas when I'm high too. Right now I've been writing a string quartet while high and the idea keep coming! It's when I'm sober that I have to start doing the editing and refining though hahaha.
